title: Submit a Slurm job with Slinky

scenes.heading: Run a familiar Slurm job
voice: Your team submits GPU jobs with Slurm.
How do you get that same workflow on a Kubernetes cluster?

scenes.heading: Choose the Slurm platform
scenes.sub: Render the control and worker placement
voice: Resolve the EKS H100 training recipe with Slurm as the platform.
Bundle the stack with your system and GPU node placement, then install it through the deployer.

scenes.heading: Validate before submitting jobs
scenes.sub: Check Slurm health and GPU access
voice: Run deployment and conformance validation on the installed stack.
The Slurm checks cover the login and scheduling path, and this cloud recipe checks GPU access.

scenes.heading: See the GPU Slurm assigned
scenes.sub: Submit a smoke job from the login pod
voice: From the login pod, submit a small srun job requesting one GPU.
When the job runs, the command lists the GPU visible to that job.

viewer: Slurm user bringing a familiar job to Kubernetes
payoff: An EKS H100 cluster gains Slinky through an AICR recipe, and an srun smoke job confirms the assigned GPU is visible.
